name: Master of Research
previous: The Master of Research at Swinburne University of Technology is a two-year full-time research degree in which students undertake supervised research in a discipline of their choice across the humanities, arts, social sciences and other fields. It fosters independent research skills and is ideal preparation for PhD study or a research career. Graduates continue to doctoral study or work in research roles. Indicative international tuition is around 42,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 046751C.
description:
The Master of Research at Swinburne University of Technology is a two-year full-time research degree in which students undertake supervised research in a discipline of their choice across the humanities, arts, social sciences and other fields. Indicative international tuition is around 42,400 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 046751C.
The course code is MR-INTHAS (CRICOS 094718F), in the field of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences. It takes 2 years full-time or the equivalent part-time at the Hawthorn campus, with entry in Research Period 1.

name: Graduate Certificate of Research and Innovation Management
previous: The Graduate Certificate of Research and Innovation Management at Swinburne University of Technology is a six-month program designed to enhance the experience, career prospects and employability of PhD students. Coursework is completed alongside a PhD program, delivered through online units and on-campus workshops with assessments embedded in existing PhD milestones. Graduates strengthen their research leadership and translation skills for academic and industry careers.
description:

Graduates strengthen their research leadership and translation skills for academic and industry careers.
This course is only available to international students. It runs for 6 months, studied full-time in a multi-modal format at the Hawthorn campus, with entry in Semester 2 (course code GC-RESIM).

name: Doctor of Psychology (Clinical and Forensic Psychology)
previous: The Doctor of Psychology (Clinical and Forensic Psychology) at Swinburne University of Technology is a four-year full-time program that trains highly qualified researchers and clinicians to work in clinical and forensic psychology. It combines doctoral research training with supervised clinical practice and leads toward area of practice endorsement after additional supervised practice. Graduates work as registered psychologists in clinical and forensic settings and in research. Indicative international tuition is around 44,700 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 083182B.
description:

The course code is DR-CFPSY (CRICOS 083182B). It takes 4 years of full-time study at the Hawthorn campus, with a maximum candidature of 4 years and entry in Research Period 1.

name: Master of Science (Research)
previous: The Master of Science (Research) at Swinburne University of Technology is a two-year full-time research degree in which students advance their scientific knowledge and research skills through supervised research on real-world challenges. Indicative international tuition is around 47,100 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 008343A.

name: Master of Law (Research)
previous: The Master of Law (Research) at Swinburne University of Technology is a two-year full-time research degree in which students undertake supervised research in a legal discipline of their choice. Candidates develop independent thinking, project management, data analysis, critical thinking and communication skills, and the degree is ideal preparation for PhD study or a research career. Graduates work in legal research, policy and academia. Indicative international tuition is around 42,000 Australian dollars per year. The course holds CRICOS registration 096402K.
